<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/resource-types/{type}/resources"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Paginated query for resources of the specified type. Only filtering conditions declared in query.properties of the resource type definition can be used. Passing in undeclared query parameters will return 400.
parentId is only applicable to hierarchical resources that declare this filter; protocolId is only applicable to protocol resources. page defaults to 1, pageSize defaults to 20, max 100.
sort format is `field:asc` or `field:desc`, field must appear in query.sortable; if not passed, uses the resource type definition's defaultSort.
Pagination results do not calculate total, hasMore indicates whether there is a next page. You can use GET /resource-types/\{type\} to get the current runtime rules before calling.
